punchline: Robin Sharma treats rest as one of the two halves of high performance, not a break from it.
thirty_sec: When we want to do more, we cut rest first. In The 5AM Club, Robin Sharma says that's a mistake. He describes twin cycles: a stretch of intense, focused work, then a stretch of deep recovery. Skip the second and you don't get further, you just wear yourself out. His advice is to plan recovery into your day and week ahead of time, not wait until you're exhausted.
question: What actually helps you recover after a hard week, and when did you last get to do it?
